domain: Helper relationships, visual tokens, Field Sales, reference date, localization
summary: This domain is the connective tissue: the colour/icon token tables (D.CAT, D.DEPT, D.F_COLOR, D.GROUP_COLOR, D.ATYPE_COLOR, D.STATUS), the formatting helpers (D.fmt, D.ago, D.inkOn, D.setMonths), the single clock (D.TODAY), the competitor crop axis (D.CROP_COLS), and the Field Sales inbound module (D.FIELD_MESSAGES, D.TSR, parseField/sendComposer/simulateInbound). Most of it really is presentation and can stay, but four pieces smuggle facts: D.CAT is not only colour and icon — its `label` ("Pest Control"/"Disease Control"/"Weed Control") is rendered as the big category chip via `catLabel` (portale.html:2450, markup 219 and 305), so every `|| D.CAT.disease` fallback (2819, 3139, 3207) prints a pest/disease/weed CLASSIFICATION that reality did not supply; D.F_COLOR is the enumeration of a 7-value future-signal status vocabulary that the real FUTURE_SIGNALS records do not have (measured: 3/3 real signals have status null, so all 7 filter chips count 0); D.GROUP_COLOR keys a source-group taxonomy that 31/31 real IG.SOURCES records lack (AM sources `group` is null 31/31); and D.FIELD_MESSAGES — 18 explicitly synthetic WhatsApp messages — is merged into `allMessages` (2603) and then rendered on two CORE screens: the Opportunity case panel "SEGNALI DI CAMPO · N" (2637, markup 403-408) and the Crop Windows "WHY PREPARE NOW?" reason row (2741, markup 764). Field Sales itself is correctly built as a separate INTEGRAZIONI · DEMO nav group, inbound only, with no phone number and no outbound send anywhere in the package. There is exactly one second clock: italy-briefs.js:119 calls `new Date()` for the brief timestamp. Italian is default and the language switch does not reload.
realSource: Visual tokens have no real source and do not need one — they move from window.ITALY_DEMO into a new AM.UI namespace in italy-app-model.js. The one fact they currently carry, the pest/disease/weed classification, comes from window.ITALY_CANONICAL.windows[].ISSUE_TYPE (measured 29/29 non-null: PEST 15, DISEASE 9, WEED 5) surfaced as AM.collections.windows.records[].issueType. The reference date comes from AM.referenceDate / AM.REF (2026-09-02, from ITALY_CANONICAL.meta.referenceDate). Localization comes from window.SINTONIA_I18N (371 keys, it + en both complete). Field Sales stays on AM.collections.fieldMessages (18 records, provenance SYNTHETIC_DEMO) but is confined to the isField screen. The competitor crop axis, if it survives, must come from IG.COMP_ACTIVITIES[].crops (Latin binomials plus Italian generics: Zea mays 67, Vitis vinifera 42, cereali 24, Olea europaea 24, colture 59, ... with 320/503 records carrying no crop at all).

occurrences.snippet: const fStatuses = Object.keys(D.F_COLOR);
occurrences.reason: This is the one that hurts. It reads the KEY LIST — the seven-value vocabulary NEW SIGNAL / GAINING ATTENTION / MULTIPLE SIGNALS / WATCH CLOSELY / NEEDS VALIDATION / TIMING APPROACHING / PREPARE — and builds the Future Radar status filter row from it (line 3152). Measured, the real records have no STATUS field: AM.collections.futureSignals.records all have status === null (3/3). modelChanges.why: Visual tokens are legitimate (§4) but must not live in the demo fixture, because the fixture is going away and because reading them from ITALY_DEMO is what let a colour lookup smuggle a classification label. Moving them makes the view dumb and makes every remaining D.* read a real defect.
fields: CATEGORY: { pest, disease, weed, unknown } — each { key, label, color, dark, soft, ink, body, muted, icon, aShape }
STATUS: status code -> { color, text, rank } plus a DEFAULT entry

risks: The Field Sales containment removes visible content from two core screens (the Opportunity case panel and one Crop Windows why-row). Screens get emptier. §3 says a smaller truthful screen beats a dense fake one, and §12 says do not redesign to compensate — but someone will see the gap and ask for it to be filled. Have the answer ready before the edit lands.

Deleting the Future Radar status chip row leaves that screen with three real signals, no status, no category and a REGION that literally reads 'NAO SEI — o recorte cientifico e por afiliacao nacional, nao por regiao de estudo'. It will look broken. It is not broken; it is honest. That screen may need a deliberate empty-state, which is a design decision, not an engineering one.

AM.UI.CATEGORY.unknown has label:null and icon:''. Any markup binding that assumes a non-empty icon URL will render a broken image box. Lines 221, 287, 303, 756, 917, 1530, 1809, 2160, 2177, 2307, 2332 all bind category.icon — every one needs an sc-if guard, and it is easy to miss one.

D.DEPT currently has all six colours identical (#978B87). Moving to AM.UI.DEPARTMENT is a pure copy, so nothing changes visually — which means a mistake here is silent. Diff the rendered colours, do not trust the copy.

The competitor crop axis change is the highest-variance item. Swapping in real Latin binomials will change every number in the matrix, the density strip and the compMoments cards at once, and the demo-tuned HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW thresholds will misfire. Consider shipping the axis change behind the competitor spec's own review rather than as part of this one.

italy-briefs.js:119 currently timestamps briefs with the real wall clock AND formats with 'en-GB'. Changing it to AM.referenceDate means every generated brief will say 02 Sep 2026 forever. That is correct under §6 but will read oddly to a presenter — it needs a caption saying the brief is generated against the intelligence reference date.

The localization counts are measurements with known noise. 431 markup text runs is a count of visible text fragments between tags, which over-counts split labels and under-counts text hidden inside attributes. 541 dc-script literals comes from a real JS string tokenizer with Italian-detection and CSS filtering, but a spot-read shows some are status codes and internal keys rather than user-visible copy. Treat both as order-of-magnitude ranking signals for prioritising screens, not as a work-item count.
Line 3372's fabricated history is claimed by both this spec and the researchers spec. If both engineers delete it the second edit conflicts; if neither does, it ships.
openQuestions: Future Radar has no real status vocabulary. Should the screen show three unstatused signals with a plain 'DA VALIDARE' treatment, or should the whole status dimension disappear until upstream supplies one? This is a product call, not an engineering one.

IG.SOURCES.TYPE has 12 values and the demo taxonomy had 6 buckets. Is there an intended mapping from the 12 to a smaller presentation grouping, or should the six KPI tiles be replaced by counts over the raw 12?

Is the competitor crop axis meant to be species-level? Four of the 15 real terms ('colture', 'cereali', 'frutta', 'ortaggi', 96 activities between them) are Italian generic buckets. Merging them into species rows would be a fabrication; keeping them makes a mixed-granularity axis.

The department list and the planning lead offsets are ADAMA internal routing configuration. §1 says core must not require CRM/sell-in/pipeline — configuration is not that, but should the whole 'WHO SHOULD PREPARE · WHEN' component be moved under the INTEGRAZIONI · DEMO group alongside Field Sales, rather than sitting on a core window screen with a small caption?

D.KPI.people is 39 of which only 14 are real, and 7 of the demo ones are the synthetic TSR reps that italy-demo-data.js:777 adds with `KPI.people += TSR.length`. That inflated number feeds the Fonti nav count (K.orgs + K.people = 92). It is the sources spec's field, but it is the Field Sales fixture doing the inflating — who fixes it?

italy-i18n.js has 371 keys per language. Roughly a thousand user-visible strings are outside it. Is the goal full coverage, or Italian-correct on the screens a pilot actually demos (Radar, Crop Windows, Competitors, Field Sales) with English tolerated elsewhere?
